name: Chests Of Cai Shen – Infinity

features.name: Coin-triggered respins
features.description: Coloured coins collected in the base game can randomly start three respins with up to four modifiers.

features.name: Four modifiers
features.description: Boosted money values, multiplier zones up to 100x, an extra respin, or a second 5×3 grid.

features.name: Full-grid prize
features.description: Sticky money symbols reset the respins, and filling every position adds an extra 5,000x prize.

review:
A respin game where the base game is mostly a route into the feature. Coloured coins land and fill chests above the grid, and any can randomly trigger three respins with up to four modifiers.

Green upgrades three money symbols, blue adds multiplier zones up to 100x, purple adds a respin and red plays on two grids; a quad coin can switch on several at once. Money symbols up to 150x stick and reset the respins, and a full grid adds 5,000x. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
